questions.question: If the difference of the mode and median of a data is 38, then the difference of the median and mean is:
questions.solution:
Given:

The difference between the mode and median of a data is 38

Concept used:

Mode = 3 Median – 2 Mean

Calculation:

According to the question,

Mode - Median = 38

We know,

Mode = 3 Median – 2 Mean

⇒ 3 Median - Mode = 2 Mean

⇒ 2 Median + (Median - Mode) = 2 Mean

⇒ 2 Median - 38 = 2 Mean

⇒ 2 (Median - Mean) = 38

⇒ Median - Mean = 19

**∴ The difference between the median and mean is 19.**

Range = The difference between the largest number and smallest number

questions.question:
The data given below shows the marks obtained by various students.

 
 

 
 
Marks

 
 
 
Number of students

 
 
 

 
 
10 – 12 

 
 
 
6

 
 
 

 
 
12 – 14 

 
 
 
8

 
 
 

 
 
14 – 16

What is the mean marks (Correct up to two decimal places) of given data?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use assumed mean (A) = 15.

Deviations (d = x − A) are −4, −2, 0, 2, 4 for the respective class mid-points.

Net deviation = 6 × (−4) + 8 × (−2) + 5 × 0 + 7 × 2 + 4 × 4 = −10.

Average deviation = −10 ÷ 30 = −0.33.

Actual Mean = 15 − 0.33 = 14.67.

**∴ The correct answer is 14.67.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Class intervals and corresponding frequencies representing marks of students.

**Formula Used:**

Mean = Σ(f × x) ÷ Σf

Where x = Mid-point of class interval = (Lower limit + Upper limit) ÷ 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ For 10 − 12: x = 11, f = 6 → f × x = 66

⇒ For 12 − 14: x = 13, f = 8 → f × x = 104

⇒ For 14 − 16: x = 15, f = 5 → f × x = 75

⇒ For 16 − 18: x = 17, f = 7 → f × x = 119

⇒ For 18 − 20: x = 19, f = 4 → f × x = 76

⇒ Total Frequency (Σf) = 6 + 8 + 5 + 7 + 4 = 30

⇒ Total Sum Σ(f × x) = 66 + 104 + 75 + 119 + 76 = 440

⇒ Mean = 440 ÷ 30 = 44 ÷ 3

⇒ Mean = 14.666...

⇒ Rounding to two decimal places = 14.67

**∴ The correct answer is 14.67.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Direct Mean Method

Mean = Σ(f × x) ÷ Σf, where x is the mid-point of the class interval and f is the frequency. It is best used when numerical values of x and f are small.

Assumed Mean Method

Mean = A + [Σ(f × d) ÷ Σf], where A is the assumed mean and d = x − A. This heavily simplifies calculations when values of x and f are large.

Step-Deviation Method

Mean = A + h × [Σ(f × u) ÷ Σf], where u = (x − A) ÷ h and h is the common class width. This further reduces calculation complexity for grouped distributions.

questions.question: The median of a set of 11 distinct observations is 17.5. If each of the largest 5 observations of the set is increased by 3, then the median of the new set:

options.text: is three times of the original number
remains the same as that of the original set

questions.solution:
**Given:**

The median of the set of 11 distinct observations is 17.5.

**Concept used:**

Median of set of n observation = [(n + 1)/2]th observation

**Calculation:**

[(n + 1)/2]th observation observation = 6th observation

∵ The 6th observation is not changed.

**∴ The median of the new set remains the same.**
